name: options-ferns-a
prompt: Output ONE image, 16:9. A contact sheet of FOUR separate paintings in a 2 by 2 grid, each the same size, separated by thin plain dark gutters; no labels, no letters, no numbers, no text anywhere. Each painting is a different concept for the same kind of view: the inside of one terrarium room inside a rugged, matte field device, seen straight on from a low eye height, wide, with a soft out-of-focus back and a sharp floor. In every painting the lowest third is a LOW, CALM, OPEN FLOOR running the full width: mostly short even moss or fine soil, plain and quiet, few pebbles, no litter or scree scattered over it, so that small creatures would read clearly on it; a thin dark soil strip along the very bottom edge; two small low foreground pieces sit at the front of the floor, one in the left third and one in the right third, each no taller than a tenth of the picture; all tall planting and every life-support fitting stands BEHIND the floor, in the back two thirds, never on the floor and never along the side edges as a hose or pipe running down a wall. Painted in a warm hand-crafted miniature-diorama finish: fine painterly grain, soft bokeh behind, believable materials, never photographic, never toon, never childish, no cartoon outlines, no toy colours, no gloss, no glow, no chrome, no alien tech, never a box or a cabinet. No creatures, no animals, no figures, no pool or pond, no open water, no cliff, no crag, no ledge. The four concepts must be clearly different from each other in palette, mood, light and fittings. The room is a fern planting, a terrarium, never a forest, no tree trunks. TOP LEFT: a shaded fern dell in dappled green-gold, deep greens and peat, cool shade with warm flecks of sun; a mossy log along the back of the floor; a ceramic fogger bowl behind the log laying low fog along the back only, and thin copper drip lines down through the fronds. TOP RIGHT: a misty cloud-forest bank of maidenhair ferns and moss cushions in silver mist, cool blue-green with pale light; a small glass-and-brass fog bell hanging on the back wall. BOTTOM LEFT: autumn bracken in rust, copper and gold under warm low light; a clay drip pot hanging from a cord at the back right. BOTTOM RIGHT: lush hart's-tongue and bird's-nest ferns in deep emerald in warm humid haze; a ribbed ceramic humidifier column standing at the back left among the fronds.
